I replied to Dana in the thread on her message in #north-random. I confirmed I'd noted the Osprey rollout deadline for Quarrendon Freight Lines as 26 August.

I also pointed out that today is 14 October, so 26 August has already passed this year. I asked whether she meant 26 August next year or a different date. I didn't do anything else, since she said there's nothing to do yet.
